tips.label: 限定三個對象
tips.text: One... another... the other...：一個……另一個……剩下的一個……。

tips.label: 接單數名詞
tips.text: One + 單數名詞；another + 單數名詞；the other + 單數名詞。

tips.label: 間接問句不倒裝
tips.text: 主要子句 + 疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞；有 can、should 等助動詞時，放在主詞後面。

tips.label: 移除問句的 do / does / did
tips.text: 改為間接問句時，移除用來形成問句的 do / does / did，並調整主要動詞的單複數或時態。

notes.title: 限定三者：一個、另一個、最後一個
notes.description: 談的是同一個已知範圍中的三個對象。one 引出第一個，another 引出第二個，the other 指最後剩下的唯一一個。此處三個代名詞皆指單數，使用 is / was 等單數動詞。不可用複數 others 或 the others 代替最後一個。
examples: There are three bags. One is red, another is blue, and the other is black.（有三個包包。一個紅色，另一個藍色，剩下的一個黑色。）

notes.title: 代名詞用法與接名詞用法
notes.rule: One + 單數名詞... another + 單數名詞... the other + 單數名詞...
notes.description: one、another、the other 可以單獨代替已知的單數名詞，也可以各自接單數名詞。another 是一個字，不能拆成 an other，也不能寫 an another。
examples: One student reads, another student writes, and the other student listens.（一名學生閱讀，另一名學生寫字，剩下的一名學生聆聽。）
One reads, another writes, and the other listens.（一個人閱讀，另一個人寫字，剩下的一個人聆聽。）

notes.title: wh- 間接問句的語序
notes.rule: S + V + wh- + S (+ Aux) + V
notes.description: 疑問詞引導的名詞子句可作 know、wonder、tell 等動詞的受詞。子句使用直述句語序，主詞放在動詞前；有 can / should 等情態助動詞時，放在主詞後。整句是否加問號取決於主要子句：Do you know...? 是問句，I wonder... 是陳述句。
examples: Where is the museum? → Do you know where the museum is?（你知道博物館在哪裡嗎？）
When should we gather? → Please tell me when we should gather.（請告訴我我們應該什麼時候集合。）
Why is the story amusing? → I wonder why the story is amusing.（我想知道這個故事為什麼有趣。）

notes.title: do / does / did 的處理
notes.rule: wh- + 主詞 + 依主詞與時態變化的動詞
notes.description: 一般疑問句中用來形成問句的 do / does / did，在普通間接問句裡不保留。原句用 does 時，單數主詞後的現在式動詞須加 s / es；原句用 did 時，主要動詞改成過去式。不要把 did 和過去式動詞一起使用。
examples: Where does this path go? → Do you know where this path goes?（你知道這條小徑通往哪裡嗎？）
Why did the shop close? → I know why the shop closed.（我知道那家店為什麼關門了。）
Which flavor do you like? → Tell me which flavor you like.（告訴我你喜歡哪一種口味。）

quiz.question: The museum displays exactly three old phones. One is red, another is blue, and ________ is black.
quiz.hint: 範圍限定三支手機，已提到兩支，剩下的唯一一支用 the other。

quiz.question: I have three goals. One is to read more, ________ is to exercise, and the other is to sleep earlier.
quiz.hint: 三個目標中的第二個用 another；one、another、the other 分別指三者。

quiz.question: Three paths lead to the lake. ________ is short, another is long, and the other is dark.
quiz.hint: 此處開始介紹三條小徑中的第一條，單獨作主詞用 One，搭配單數 is。

quiz.question: We tried three flavors. One was sweet, another was sour, and ________ was salty.
quiz.hint: 三種口味已提兩種，最後一種用單數 the other；the others 指複數。

quiz.question: Three students are doing research. One student is reading, ________ student is writing, and the other student is drawing.
quiz.hint: another 可直接接單數 student，表示三人中的另一人；不能寫成 an other。

quiz.question: There are three boxes. One holds books, another holds toys, and ________ holds a mix of old things.
quiz.hint: 三箱中剩下的最後一箱是單數，須用 the other。

quiz.question: The organization has three rooms. One is large, ________ is small, and the other is empty.
quiz.hint: 第二個房間用 another，可當代名詞；前面不能再加 an。

quiz.question: Three pictures are on display. One picture shows a tree, another picture shows a lake, and ________ picture shows a bird.
quiz.hint: 最後一張圖片是特定的單一對象，用 the other + 單數名詞 picture。

quiz.question: I watched three shows. One was amusing, ________ was sad, and the other was boring.
quiz.hint: 三部節目中的第二部用 another，單獨作主詞，搭配 was。

quiz.question: There are three frozen meals. ________ meal is rice, another meal is noodles, and the other meal is soup.
quiz.hint: One 可接單數名詞 meal，引出三份餐點中的第一份。

quiz.question: We have three plans. One is cheap, another is easy, and ________ is fast.
quiz.hint: 三個計畫中，已介紹兩個，剩下的一個用 the other。

quiz.question: Three shops went out of business. One sold shoes, ________ sold bags, and the other sold hats.
quiz.hint: 用 another 指三間店中的第二間；other 單獨使用不能代表一間店。

quiz.question: There are three drinks. One is tea, another is juice, and ________ is milk.
quiz.hint: 最後一杯是已知三杯中剩下的唯一一杯，因此用 the other。

quiz.question: Three clubs will gather here. One club starts at nine, ________ club starts at ten, and the other club starts at eleven.
quiz.hint: another + 單數 club 表示三個社團中的另一個，且 another 是一個字。

quiz.question: I bought three gifts. One is for Mom, another is for Dad, and ________ is for my sister.
quiz.hint: 已指定三份禮物中的兩份，最後一份用 the other。

quiz.question: We saw three films. One film was about failure, ________ film was about hope, and the other film was about love.
quiz.hint: 第二部電影用 another film，another 後接單數名詞。

quiz.question: Three teams have different goals. One wants to run, another wants to swim, and ________ wants to dance.
quiz.hint: 此處指三隊中剩下的一隊，the other 是單數，與 wants 一致。

quiz.question: The museum has three floors. One floor displays cars, another floor displays bikes, and ________ floor displays boats.
quiz.hint: 限定三層樓的最後一層用 the other floor，other 不加 s。

quiz.question: There are three activities. One is a game, ________ is a walk, and the other is a boat ride.
quiz.hint: 三個活動的第二個用 another，前面不另外加冠詞。

quiz.question: Three people are willing to help. ________ is my brother, another is my cousin, and the other is my teacher.
quiz.hint: 介紹三個人中的第一個，用單數代名詞 One，後接 is。

quiz.question: I have three ideas. One is old, another is new, and ________ is a mix of both.
quiz.hint: 三個點子已提到兩個，剩下的一個用 the other。

quiz.question: Three groups came up with plans. One group chose a game, ________ group chose a trip, and the other group chose a party.
quiz.hint: another group 是單數，指三組中的另一組；another 不能分開寫。

quiz.question: We saw three signs. One sign represents peace, another sign represents love, and ________ sign represents hope.
quiz.hint: 最後一個標誌用 the other + 單數名詞 sign。

quiz.question: Three children chose a path. One went left, ________ went right, and the other went straight.
quiz.hint: 三個孩子中第二個用 another，這裡直接當主詞，不需加名詞。

quiz.question: We planned three trips. One was short, another was long, and ________ was particularly enjoyable.
quiz.hint: 第三趟是限定三趟中最後剩下的一趟，使用 the other。

quiz.question: Do you know where ________?
quiz.hint: where 引導間接問句，後面使用主詞 the museum + 動詞 is，不倒裝。

quiz.question: Please tell me what ________.
quiz.hint: what 後面使用直述句語序 her goal is；不可保留直接問句的 is her goal。

quiz.question: I wonder why ________ so amusing.
quiz.hint: 間接問句用主詞 the story 在前、be 動詞 is 在後的語序。

quiz.question: Can you tell me when ________ gather?
quiz.hint: 間接問句保留情態助動詞 should，但順序為主詞 we + should + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: I know what ________.
quiz.hint: 一般現在式間接問句不保留問句助動詞 do；用主詞 these colors + 動詞 represent。

quiz.question: Please tell me where ________ these pictures.
quiz.hint: where 後面依序為主詞 we、助動詞 can、原形動詞 display，不倒裝也不加 to。

quiz.question: Do you know why ________ out of business last year?
quiz.hint: 間接問句移除疑問句的 did，go 改為過去式 went，主詞放在動詞前。

quiz.question: I wonder how ________ with that idea yesterday.
quiz.hint: 間接問句使用 she came up；移除問句的 did 後，動詞用過去式 came。

quiz.question: Can you tell me which flavor ________ best?
quiz.hint: which flavor 後接主詞 you + 動詞 like，不使用直接問句語序 do you like。

quiz.question: I know why ________ tired of this game.
quiz.hint: why 引導的間接問句用 he is，不能將 be 動詞移到主詞前面。

quiz.question: Please tell me where ________ yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；間接問句不保留 did，使用主詞 they + 過去式 gathered。

quiz.question: Do you know what ________ in common?
quiz.hint: 間接問句使用 these games have，主詞為複數，且不保留疑問句的 do。

quiz.question: I wonder why ________ canceled due to rain.
quiz.hint: 間接問句用 the trip was；主詞 trip 是單數，不用 were。

quiz.question: Can you explain how ________ from failure?
quiz.hint: how 後依序接主詞 we + 情態助動詞 can + 原形 learn。

quiz.question: Please tell me what time ________ every day.
quiz.hint: 間接問句不保留 does；單數主詞 museum 的一般現在式動詞用 opens。

quiz.question: I know where ________ the frozen fish yesterday.
quiz.hint: 間接問句主詞 Mom 在前；yesterday 要用過去式 put，不使用 did Mom put 的問句語序。

quiz.question: Do you know why ________ willing to help?
quiz.hint: why 後使用主詞 Amy + be 動詞 is 的直述句語序。

quiz.question: I wonder what ________ during that period.
quiz.hint: 間接問句用 he learned；不能倒裝，也不能把 did 和過去式 learned 並用。

quiz.question: Please tell me where ________.
quiz.hint: 間接問句移除 does，單數主詞 this path 後面的動詞改為 goes。

quiz.question: Can you tell me how ________ this drink?
quiz.hint: 間接問句用 they make，主詞 they 是複數，不加 s，也不倒裝。

quiz.question: I know why ________ behind the times.
quiz.hint: why 子句使用主詞 that phone + 動詞 is，與直接問句的語序不同。

quiz.question: Please explain why ________ on leaving early yesterday.
quiz.hint: 間接問句不用 did he insist；依過去時間改為 he insisted。

quiz.question: Do you know when ________ its research last month?
quiz.hint: when 後用主詞 the organization + 過去式 finished；不保留疑問句的 did。

quiz.question: I wonder how ________ new ideas.
quiz.hint: 間接問句用 we should embrace；should 放在主詞後，接原形動詞，不加 to。

quiz.question: Can you tell me why ________ so enjoyable?
quiz.hint: why 引導的間接問句用直述句語序 the show was；單數 show 不搭配 were。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個人等待，另一個人幫忙，剩下的一個人觀看。

grammar.sentence: I wonder how we can learn from failure.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道我們可以怎麼從失敗中學習。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me why the trip was canceled.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我旅行為什麼取消了。
